shared_elements: horizontal register or band of repeated pattern
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces use relief/linear carving with profile animals and profile human figures, plus some horizontal banding or patterned registers. The biggest difference is compositional: A is a broad, pale, relatively naturalistic frieze dominated by one large animal and a floral border, while B is a rougher vertical slab divided into stacked, crowded, schematic registers.
